## Overview

This directory contains Enterprise Standards related to information security, cybersecurity, compliance, and risk management to ensure consistent security posture across the enterprise.
page_texts.4:
[standards/security/README.md#examples-of-security-standards]

## Examples of Security Standards

- Information security policy frameworks for comprehensive security governance
- Access control and identity management standards for secure system access
- Data encryption and protection standards for sensitive information security
- Security incident response procedures for effective breach management
- Vulnerability management and remediation standards for proactive security
- Security awareness and training requirements for human risk mitigation
- Compliance monitoring and reporting standards for regulatory adherence
- Third-party security assessment standards for vendor risk management
- Application security standards for secure software development
- Network security standards for infrastructure protection
